statement: Never override the commit author or committer in this estate's repositories, not even to mark a commit as an agent's: identity here is the operator's git config, and the CLA check reads it. 2026-11-20: a lane session preserved an interrupted goal run's uncommitted records with git -c user.name=Claude -c user.email=noreply@anthropic.com. The PR built on that branch (cejel #754) failed its cla check, because that identity has not signed the CLA. A force-push to repair the branch was refused, so the same commits were rewritten with the operator's identity onto a new branch and opened as #755, and #754 was closed. Fix: commit with the repository's configured identity and say 'agent-authored' in the message and the Co-Authored-By trailer. This seed moves when a pre-push or CI check refuses a commit whose author is not a CLA signer before a PR is opened.

movesWhen.reason: No check refuses a non-signer author before a PR is opened; the cla check reports it only after.
